summary: A multi-application Nd:YAG/Er:YAG laser platform, most often used at Kaiteki for its Fotona 4D facial-firming protocol.
leadAnswer: Fotona Laser is Kaiteki's Fotona SP Dynamis / TimeWalker platform, an Nd:YAG and Er:YAG laser system with several application modes. Its main facial protocol, Fotona 4D, combines four modes — one delivered from inside the mouth — for facial firmness and skin-quality concerns. A doctor decides which modes, if any, suit you.
seoTitle: Fotona 4D Laser Skin Tightening Malaysia | Kaiteki
seoDescription: Fotona 4D is a multi-mode laser used for facial firming and skin quality, doctor-assessed at Kaiteki clinics in Malaysia. Book a free consultation on WhatsApp.

facts.label: Nd:YAG and Er:YAG, combined in one protocol
A full protocol, depending on how many modes are included
Your first visit is a doctor consultation, not a treatment

routes.title: Laxity treated from inside the mouth outwards
routes.body: Early to moderate laxity of the lower face, where firmness and skin quality are both part of the picture rather than descent alone.

routes.title: Firmness and surface quality in the same course
routes.body: Loss of firmness alongside surface texture and fine lines.

variantModule.heading: The four modes, and what each one does
variantModule.intro: Fotona 4D runs four laser modes in a set sequence, each working at a different level of the skin.

items.title: SMOOTH
items.body: Delivered from inside the mouth, to the tissue behind the cheeks and around the nasolabial region.

items.title: FRAC3
items.body: A fractional mode that reaches deeper layers of the skin to target imperfections such as pigmentation and lines.

items.title: PIANO
items.body: A bulk-heating mode that warms deeper tissue in a gradual, controlled way, working below the skin surface.

items.title: Superficial peel
items.body: A light resurfacing pass over the skin surface intended to smooth texture.

ctaMid.heading: Not sure whether a laser or another energy suits your laxity?
ctaMid.body: Fotona 4D, focused ultrasound and radiofrequency reach tissue in different ways. A doctor can compare them for your face.

avoidIf.lead: Active infection, cold sores or inflamed skin
avoidIf.body: in the area to be treated.

avoidIf.lead: Oral or dental conditions, recent dental work or oral appliances,
avoidIf.body: because one step is delivered from inside the mouth.

sessionSteps.title: Consultation and assessment
sessionSteps.body: The doctor decides which modes suit your face, and in what order.

sessionSteps.title: Preparation
sessionSteps.body: The skin is cleansed and make-up removed, eye protection is fitted, and you are positioned and prepared separately for the intraoral step.

sessionSteps.title: The protocol
sessionSteps.body: The modes are performed in sequence. Most patients describe spreading warmth rather than sharp pain, including against the inner cheek during the intraoral step.

bands.title: The same day
bands.body: Flushing, warmth and a mild tight feeling for a few hours to a day are common, and the skin can look slightly pink after the surface pass. Most people return to normal activities the same day.

bands.title: The first few days
bands.body: Keep skincare gentle and well moisturised, and pause retinoids and acids until your doctor says otherwise.

afterSession.aftercare: Use daily broad-spectrum sunscreen, and avoid heat such as saunas and hot yoga for the period your doctor specifies.

risks.common: Redness, warmth, mild swelling, transient dryness or flaking, and temporary sensitivity of the inner cheek or lips after the intraoral step.
risks.lessCommon: Cold sores can be reactivated in people prone to them. Burns, blistering, changes in pigmentation and scarring are uncommon.
risks.pigmentNote: Fotona notes that the Nd:YAG wavelength's low absorption in melanin allows use across skin types, and the Er:YAG surface pass is kept light in a 4D protocol. A history of pigment change after heat, lasers or inflammation still needs raising before treatment.
cannotDo: It is aimed at early to moderate laxity rather than significant sagging, where a doctor may tell you a laser is not the right tool.
It is not a single visit: the effect relies on gradual tissue remodelling across a course.
risks.disclose: Tell your doctor if you are prone to cold sores.

costFactors.intro: Kaiteki does not quote prices online, because cost depends on the plan agreed at consultation. What moves it:
factors: How many of the four modes your plan uses.
The number of sessions in the course, and any maintenance.
Whether the protocol is combined with other treatments in your plan.

relatedReasons.hifu: Focused ultrasound for laxity at a chosen depth, a different energy type from laser.
relatedReasons.ultherapy: Focused ultrasound with on-screen imaging of the tissue layers, a different energy type from laser.

sections.heading: What is Fotona Laser?
body: The Fotona SP Dynamis / TimeWalker platform combines two lasers, Nd:YAG and Er:YAG, and runs several distinct applications: NightLase (for snoring-related concerns), LipLase, SmoothEye, TightSculpting and the facial protocol Fotona 4D.

sections.heading: Why does Fotona 4D work from inside the mouth?
body: In the step Fotona calls SmoothLiftin™, the Er:YAG laser is applied in SMOOTH® mode to the inner cheek, working from within rather than through the outer skin. Fotona describes SMOOTH® mode as a rapid sequence of low-fluence pulses inside a longer pulse, producing gentle coagulative heating rather than ablation.

faqs.q: How many Fotona 4D sessions will I need?
faqs.a: Usually a course of several sessions spaced a few weeks apart, then occasional maintenance.

faqs.q: Is Fotona 4D suitable for darker or Asian skin?
faqs.a: It can be. A history of pigment change should be raised first.

faqs.q: Does Fotona 4D involve needles or injections?
faqs.a: No. It uses laser energy only, on the skin surface and inside the mouth.
It is confirmed at consultation rather than quoted online.
